32417.overview: Football is one of the earliest games that Radio Shack/Tandy released for the Coco 1 in 1980. Requiring 2 players, it is standard American football, with plays being selected by the two players simultaneously on the same screen by press the joystick button when the play you want is selected. Until both players hit a button, though, you can keep reselecting to throw your opponent off from knowing which play type you have picked.

175443.overview:
Your task in this arcade game is to guide a frog across a treacherous road and river, and to safety at the top of the screen. Both these sections are fraught with a variety of hazards, each of which will kill the frog and cost you a life if contact is made.

The road is full of cars and trucks, at variable speeds. The river water itself is fatal, as are the snakes which hover within on later levels. Frogger must use the arrangement of logs, turtles (which are only there for a short time) and alligators (but stay away from their faces), and then jump into one of the open home-cells, ideally one containing a fly for extra points. Once all holes have been filled, you move onto the next, harder, level.

176042.overview: Facemaker is a an educational game meant for younger children. At it's simplest level, you simply get to design a face by choosing different eyes, noses, ears, etc. For more advanced children, it played a Simon type game, using simple animation of the features you picked out. You had to type the body part sequence in the same order as they happened, and it would add a new motion each time you got it right, thus requiring you to memorize large sequences if you got good. Spinnaker made a lot of educational games in the 1980's, including for other platforms besides the Coco.

176043.overview: Fraction Fever is one of a line of educational games that Spinnaker Software did for multiple machines, and was sold through Radio Shack/Tandy. This particular one is for kids to learn fractions, by hopping on pogo stick to the left or the right, to match the fraction (shown at the top of the above right screenshot). If you zap the right fraction, you get to go to a higher floor, and the fractions get harder.

446865.overview:
This flight simulator simulates a real aircraft, the Piper PA-28-181 Archer II. For those with the knowledge, it offers practice with the variables of flight, including the avionics.

The game has more features than first generation flight simulators. Pilots are expected to pay attention to small details. SubLOGIC encouraged the players to go to flight stores and purchase flight-training manuals and aeronautical charts to help them understand the variables within the program. The game is oriented toward pilots-in-training, but there are options for laymen too: an easy mode, and a slightly more detailed reality mode. These modes do not require the same level of knowledge.

446866.overview:
FlightSim I puts the player inside the cockpit, behind the controls of a high performance jet. This game is in the conception of the Flight Simulator computer game series but for the TRS-80 Color Computer.

The simulation environment consists of approximately 22,185 square miles and recreates most of the conditions normally encountered in actual flight. The player can fly the jet to any of eight airports or nine landmarks scattered throughout the simulation area.

464438.overview:
Make love not war? Not with these sultry FEMBOTS! What a tale you 'll tell IF you live to tell it! Cold steel never felt so HOT!

The color and excitement of ARCADE ACTION combined with the sophistication. intellectual challenge and skill of an ADVENTURE GAME doesn't fully describe this cosmic shoot'em up

Shooting aliens on a flat screen is nothing like blowing Fembots away in 3-D! You come face to face with the ubiquitous Fembots, the powerful Arthroks, and the omnipotent Optikon. With your lasgun blasting, you hear the explosion and the crunching of metal. You feel the tension as you stalk the elusive Guardians and search for the Destruct Button.

464905.overview: While flying in a copter over a huge city in the bird's eye view the object of Fire Copter is to extinguish as many fires as possible before the entire city burns. Also fire-starting androids must be killed with the on-board lasers. The game can be played by one or two players and controlled by a joystick.

464917.overview:
You have been chosen as commander in a struggle to gain control of an unexplored section of the galaxy. Your foe: an alien race called VOLSUNG. Here in the distant future, when space travel has become commonplace, on uncharted star systems you hope to find the raw materials which are vital to your industry and construction of a fleet of space craft. 

Starting with limited ships and resources, you must quickly search, locate, and bring needed systems under your influence, before the aliens can gain a foothold and threaten your expansion.

A star system can support industry, mining, energy, or farming. You must decide on how to concentrate your efforts to maintain a balance to best serve your needs for developing your civilization and producing new space craft. Spacecraft that you will surely need when you and the alien VOLSUNGS eventually collide in a titanic struggle for control of the Final Frontier.

464923.overview: An excellent version of the Othello type board games. 1 or 2 players.

464931.overview:
Fyr-Draca (Fire Dragons) from egg to the daemonic behemoth, attack in five waves with nine colors on the screen at one time! With dazzling colors on a black background and black border, the real arcade look is here!

You've chanced upon the warren of the once thought mythical Dragon Kingdom. Many are the dragon forms that attack in five waves. Dragons swoop from their stellar watch, singly, in groups, and in squadron formation. With photon cannon blazing, you first face the single wyrms, then the squadron attack. Next the twin Fyr Draca, followed by the Battle Drake. Finally you must survive the Hatch of Doom. Even with four star vessels and shields you will be hard put to survive their spitting fire and diving attacks! 

The dazzling colors will delight your eyes; the ditties will warm your ears; the challenge will drive you crazy!

464941.overview: You must stop the mad general from launching a missile at Moscow and causing WWIII.

465048.overview:
Flight is a flight landing simulator, vs. a full flight simulator. It features 4 skill levels, high score save (on the disk version), 1 to 5 players and joystick control. The documentation mentions that one of the authors was a pilot for a major airline.

The player uses the joystick to control the plane coming in for a landing. The graphical display is divided into 3 sections vertically. The top 1/3 is the Azimuth (showing your plane's left/right accuracy coming into the runway), the middle 3rd is your Glide Path (showing your plane's vertical position relative to the runway), and both of those have center lines that you are to try and follow as close as possible. The bottom 1/3 is your instrument panel with 3 instruments. The left instrument is a combination of your Azimuth and Glide Path indicated by the two lines. The center instrument is the artificial horizon, and the one on the right is the altimeter, to tell how far above the ground and runway you are.

465059.overview:
This one will give you hours of exciting play. Cross the busy highway to the safety of the median and rest awhile before you set out across the swollen river teaming with hidden hazards. Outstanding sound and graphics.

A Frogger clone.

465094.overview: Foodwar is based on the arcade game Food Fight by Atari. It is an arcade style game where you have try to get to (and eat) an ice cream cone. Combatting you are a bunch of chef's, who come out of holes in the floor. You can combat them by picking up the other foodstuffs scattered around the screen, and throw them at the chefs.

465281.overview:
Fearless Freddy is a 1-player arcade game.

Fearless Fireman Freddy is bravely climbing the burning office block, collecting the possessions of the surviving people. Freddy can move laterally on platforms, and can descend by falling between floors, or catch a lift to higher levels. Fireballs fall from above, and move about the platforms. The player must avoid these and not fall into cauldrons of fire, while trying to collect all the possessions on the screen to move to the next level. The player has limited time to complete each level, represented by a thermometer that counts upwards to 1,000 degrees. The player starts with 5 lives represented by water buckets, with a new one awarded every 10,000 points. There are two levels of difficulty representing different level designs.

465282.overview:
Fly, by Ronald Boulanger, is the first runner up in the assembly language category of 1983's Summer Programming Project. 

Fly is fast, and will soon have your head buzzing. The object of the game is to catch as many flies as you can in three minutes. Each fly caught creates an obstacle. Be careful, you may be trapped by those obstacles. The more flies you catch, the tougher the game becomes. Each fly caught gives you one point.

465564.overview: Fighter Pilot is based on the arcade smash 1942, but minus the aircraft carriers between levels, and without the ability to flip your plane over as a dodge tactic. There is also no special bonuses to pick up to get better gunnery. On the other hand, there are multiple types of planes to shoot, and the large ones (see screenshots above) will require more than 1 hit to shoot down. Also, like the arcade, Fighter Pilot give you stats between waves, including you're shooting percentage.

465696.overview:
Fire One is a 1-player submarine game for the TRS-80 CoCo.

Played from the view inside the submarine, the player can set the heading, depth, and speed of their vessel. The player can travel via diesel or battery power to determine stealth of their vessel. When near the surface, the player can use their periscope to view 4 directions. The player starts with 10 torpedoes to target enemy vessels, and can use their deck gun when surfaced.

Game play is divided into a 4 x 4 grid consisting of open land and islands. The player receives missions to sink specific vessels. To assist with navigation and locate enemies, the player can view their radar and receive information from local quadrants. When the ship is damaged, the player can effect repairs from the repair menu, allowing for 2 minutes for each repair.
